howTo: Click Choose file and pick your SQLite database, or press Load sample database to explore a ready-made example with users and orders tables.
Pick a table from the dropdown. The schema panel shows every column with its type, nullability, and primary-key flags.
Page through the table rows with the Previous and Next controls, or change how many rows appear per page.
Type any SQL in the query box — SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, even CREATE TABLE — and press Run query.
Export what you see: download the result as CSV or copy it as tab-separated text for spreadsheets.
keyFacts: SQLite is the most widely deployed database engine in the world — it powers phones, browsers, and apps, storing an entire database in a single portable file.
This viewer runs sql.js, the official SQLite engine compiled to WebAssembly, so queries execute with genuine SQLite semantics in your browser.
Supported files: .db, .sqlite, .sqlite3, .db3 and .s3db. Files up to 100 MB open comfortably on a desktop browser.
System tables (sqlite_%) are hidden from the table list to keep the view clean.
Every session works on a private in-memory copy. Running queries here never changes your original file.

limitations: Read-mostly workflow: the database lives in memory, so changes are not saved back to your file.
Very large databases (over 100 MB) may be slow or run out of browser memory.
Encrypted or password-protected SQLite files cannot be opened — this tool has no decryption.
Exotic extensions and custom collations may behave slightly differently than native SQLite.

sqlite-database-viewer.workedExample:
The sample database has a users table with 5 rows:
1. Run: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS users FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY users DESC;
2. SQLite groups the 5 rows by city: Delhi appears twice (Aarav, Rohan), Mumbai twice (Priya, Kabir), Hyderabad once (Sana).
3. Result: Delhi 2, Mumbai 2, Hyderabad 1.
4. Try a join: SELECT u.name, o.item, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id; — it returns 4 rows: Aarav's Keyboard (2499.00) and Monitor (12499.00), Priya's Mouse (899.50), Sana's Headphones (1999.00).
